name: TM16xx
description: Arduino TM16xx library for LED & KEY and LED Matrix modules based on TM1638, TM1637, TM1640 and similar chips. Simply use print() on 7-segment and use Adafruit GFX on matrix.

paragraphs: Arduino TM16xx library for LED & KEY and LED Matrix modules based on TM1638, TM1637, TM1640 and similar chips. Simply use print() on 7-segment and 14-segment displays and use Adafruit GFX on matrix displays.
features: The current version of this library supports ESP8266/ESP32, Atmel ATmega (e.g. ATmega328 and ATmega168) and Atmel ATtiny MCUs. Due to the required memory, the smallest ATtiny MCU supported is the ATtiny44. Compatible…

The TM16xx chips offer no support for daisychaining multiple chips, but when separate latch lines are used the data and clock lines can be shared for combined displays. For two wire modules the data line can be shared…

It is possible to define multiple display objects for multiple different modules (see the TM1638TM1637extwomodules example). The library now supports combining multiple 7-segment or 14-segment modules into one display…
The TM16xxMatrixGFX class does support combining multiple LED Matrix module into one large matrix.
